title.ja: AI for Science推進委員会
title.en: AI for Science Promotion Committee

summary.ja: 研究へのAI活用を扱う委員会。公式ページに、2026年の会合と「AI for Scienceの推進に向けた基本的な戦略方針」の策定情報を掲載。
summary.en: A committee on AI for scientific research. Its official page lists meetings in 2026 and the formulation of a basic strategic policy for AI for Science.

milestone.ja: 2026年4月3日：基本的な戦略方針の策定情報
milestone.en: 3 April 2026: publication page for the basic strategic policy

title.ja: HPCI計画推進委員会
title.en: HPCI Plan Promotion Committee

summary.ja: HPCI計画の推進と計画案・進捗の評価を行う委員会。「富岳」の利活用方針や次世代計算基盤の報告書、会議資料への入口。
summary.en: Examines the HPCI plan and evaluates proposals and progress. Public materials cover Fugaku utilization policies, next-generation computing infrastructure, and committee meetings.

milestone.ja: 2024年6月：次世代計算基盤に関する報告書の最終取りまとめ
milestone.en: June 2024: final report on next-generation computing infrastructure

title.ja: 次世代HPCI環境検討ワーキンググループ
title.en: Working Group on the Next-generation HPCI Environment

summary.ja: 次世代計算基盤を見据えたHPCIの運営方針・利用制度・利活用促進を検討。HPCI整備計画調査研究と次世代HPC・AI開発支援拠点形成の審査・助言も扱う。
summary.en: Examines HPCI operations, access arrangements, and use in the next-generation computing era, and reviews and advises related HPCI planning and HPC/AI support projects.

milestone.ja: 2025年8月5日：設置文書に記載された実施開始日
milestone.en: 5 August 2025: start date specified in the founding document

title.ja: 次世代計算基盤を見据えた今後のHPCIの運営に係る検討ワーキンググループ
title.en: Working Group on Future HPCI Operations for Next-generation Computing Infrastructure

summary.ja: ポスト「富岳」時代に向け、HPCIの運営改善を集中的に検討。利用促進機関・運営委託機関、ユーザー対応、課題選定、運用機関との連携を扱う。
summary.en: Examines improvements to HPCI operations for the post-Fugaku era, including access-promotion and operating bodies, user support, project selection, and coordination with system operators.

milestone.ja: 2024年11月28日：設置文書に記載された実施開始日
milestone.en: 28 November 2024: start date specified in the founding document

title.ja: 次世代計算基盤に係るシステム検討ワーキンググループ
title.en: Working Group on Systems for Next-generation Computing Infrastructure

summary.ja: 「富岳」開発プロジェクトの事後評価と、次世代計算基盤の具体的方策を検討。システム構成や要素技術を、技術動向を踏まえて整理する。
summary.en: Conducts the ex-post evaluation of the Fugaku development project and examines concrete options for next-generation computing infrastructure, including system configurations and component technologies.

title.ja: 将来のHPCIの在り方に関する検討ワーキンググループ

summary.en: A working group examining the future of HPCI. The archived official page lists meetings in 2019 and a report published in August of that year.

milestone.en: 20 August 2019: report publication date shown on the official page

title.ja: ポスト「京」の利活用促進・成果創出加速に関するワーキンググループ

summary.en: A working group on promoting the use of post-K and accelerating research outcomes. Its archived page links meetings from 2018–2019 and a report.

milestone.en: 13 May 2019: report publication date shown on the official page

summary.en: A sub-working group concerning exploratory post-K research topics. The archived page lists meeting notices, including August 2018 and January 2019.

milestone.ja: 公開会合の例：2019年1月28日（第6回）

summary.en: The FY2018 post-K system review working group. Its official page links the June and September 2018 meetings, summaries, and materials.

milestone.ja: 公開会合：2018年6月12日・9月4日
milestone.en: Public meetings listed: 12 June and 4 September 2018

summary.en: A working group reviewing the post-K system. Its official page links the FY2017 report evaluating cost and performance.

milestone.ja: 2017年11月13日：コスト・性能評価報告書の掲載日
milestone.en: 13 November 2017: publication page for the cost/performance report

summary.en: A working group concerning post-K priority research topics. The archived page includes a 2015 membership list and meeting information from 2016–2019.

summary.en: Examines how to advance the HPCI plan. The archived page links reports and meetings, including sub-working groups on systems and industrial applications.

milestone.ja: 2014年3月14日：「今後のHPCI計画推進の在り方について」の掲載日

summary.en: Reviews applications and evaluates progress and results of research on computing infrastructure for the post-Fugaku era.

summary.en: The FY2015 working group that reviewed the basic design of post-K. Public sources include the basic-design report and a January 2016 meeting record.

note.ja: 旧一覧の終期表記と会議名の年度に食い違いがあるため、会合記録と基本設計報告書に基づいて年代を記載。
note.en: The old index’s end-date label conflicts with the fiscal year in the title; chronology here follows the meeting record and basic-design report.

summary.en: The 2014 working group on the next flagship system, distinct from the following fiscal year’s basic-design review. Its page links interim findings in July and final findings in October.

summary.en: A committee conducting the interim evaluation of the HPCI Strategic Program. The archived page links a December 2013 meeting and evaluation results in February 2014.

milestone.en: 26 February 2014: publication date of interim evaluation results
